name: void
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Void instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Void tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Void through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Void Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Void only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
